articles.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
articles.description: The Ukrainian president says US envoys touted the exchange as part of efforts to end the war with Russia.

articles.title: Military cemetery decorum: The tradition behind Hegseth's Veterans Day reprimand
articles.description: BBC's Bernd Debusmann breaks down why Defence Secretary Hegseth's group was reprimanded at Arlington National Cemetery and the history behind its strict rules of conduct.

articles.title: US asked if Ukraine would give up parts of Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskyy says
articles.description: The US has asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region if Kyiv were admitted to NATO, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Goalkeeper given 12-game ban for fatal collision with Tenerife striker
articles.description: Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 games after an on-field collision that resulted in the death of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, health ministry says
articles.description: An Israeli airstrike on a Palestinian hospital has killed at least six and wounded 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
